review.why: Tailors software, data, DevOps and PM resumes with a bullet formula, skills layout and an output template.
review.summary: Guide to optimize technical resumes: section order, how to organize the skills section, a bullet formula with scale metrics, role-specific examples (SWE, data, DevOps, PM), projects, education paths and GitHub tips, plus an output template.
strengths: Bullet formula with weak versus strong examples
Role-specific examples for SWE, data, DevOps and PM
Defines an output format for the optimization
cautions: Instructions only: no scripts, no step that matches a job offer
US-style conventions (GPA, no photo, GitHub required)
Does not forbid inventing the metrics it asks for
